rules_applied.structure: ONE problem, ONE offer, ONE pilot, ONE success metric per prospect. No AI-transformation pitches.
rules_applied.dentrx_positioning: Not used in this batch - no clinical decision support offered. If later introduced: decision-support ONLY, dentist retains full responsibility; no diagnosis-replacement, autonomous-prescribing, correctness-guarantee, or unverified compliance claims.
rules_applied.patient_ai_guardrails: All patient-facing flows below are limited to information collection, summarization, scheduling logistics, general educational guidance, escalation-signal identification, and direction to professional care. No diagnosis, prescribing, emergency replacement, or medication instructions.
rules_applied.roi_policy: No invented ROI figures. Expected outcomes are qualitative with a measurement plan.

offers.offer_name: Fame Dental After-Hours Call Capture & Booking Assistant
offers.one_sentence_pitch: We answer Fame Dental's phones after hours and during front-desk peaks, so same-day-emergency and new-patient callers get booked instead of hitting voicemail.
offers.problem_statement: 63 published open hours per week plus a same-day emergency promise create phone coverage windows that a single front desk cannot reliably staff, particularly evenings, Sundays, and peak overlaps.
offers.evidence: Published Mon-Sun hours (8AM opens, 7PM closes), '$49 Emergency Exam' same-day offer, call-first CTAs on every service card (site, fetched 2026-08-24).
offers.why_it_matters: Emergency and new-patient calls arriving outside staffed windows convert to competitors or ER visits; each is the practice's highest-intent inbound lead.
offers.proposed_ai_workflow: 1) Unanswered/off-hours caller reaches AI receptionist -> 2) collects name, concern category (non-diagnostic triage script approved by practice), insurance status -> 3) offers real booking slots from practice calendar rules -> 4) confirms via SMS with booking link -> 5) morning summary of captured calls to office manager.
offers.human_oversight: Practice-approved scripts and slot rules; all transcripts logged for next-morning staff review; any clinical question beyond triage script triggers callback handoff; AI never gives care advice.
offers.pilot_scope: After-hours window only (Mon-Sat close to 9PM + Sunday) + overflow during Tue/Wed 5-7PM peak. One location. No clinical workflows touched.
offers.success_metric: Count of appointments booked from after-hours/overflow captured calls (baseline week 1 vs weeks 2-4); secondary guardrail: zero clinical-advice escalations breached.
offers.expected_outcome: Qualitative: no high-intent caller hits voicemail; measurable baseline established by week 2. No dollar figure promised.
offers.expansion_opportunity: If capture works: extend to Spanish-language coverage, recall/reactivation lists, and benefits-verification pre-work.
offers.risk_notes: PHI handling requires signed BAA + HIPAA-aligned infrastructure BEFORE go-live; until executed, pilot restricted to non-PHI scheduling data (name+callback number only). Voicemail/carrier routing must be tested to avoid double-answer loops.
offers.proof_required: Call logs showing unanswered volume baseline; practice calendar slot rules; owner sign-off on triage script.

offers.offer_name: Star Sleep New-Patient Assessment Follow-Up Assistant (Dallas site)
offers.one_sentence_pitch: We turn every completed online sleep assessment into a structured intake summary and a booked consult, automatically, within minutes of submission.
offers.problem_statement: Seven sites funnel assessments, web forms, and physician referrals through one central line and a 'patient success team will contact you shortly' promise, making manual follow-up speed the constraint on consult conversion.
offers.evidence: 'Take Our Assessment' tool + web-form promise verbatim on sleepdallas.com (fetched 2026-08-24); single mainline 844-409-4657 across all NPPES rows; Refer-a-Patient nav section.
offers.why_it_matters: Sleep-apnea seekers compare providers quickly, and referring physicians judge responsiveness; slow first contact loses both channels.
offers.proposed_ai_workflow: 1) Assessment/form submission triggers AI intake call/SMS within 5 minutes -> 2) collects missing intake fields (non-diagnostic) -> 3) produces structured summary + urgency flags (escalation signals like severe symptoms routed to human same-day) -> 4) offers consult slots at chosen location -> 5) referral packets acknowledged to physician office with status.
offers.human_oversight: Patient-success team owns every escalated flag and can veto/auto-review any booking; weekly QA sample audit of transcripts; no medical interpretation in patient-facing copy.
offers.pilot_scope: Dallas location submissions ONLY (12770 Coit Rd). Excludes existing patients, billing, and clinical documents.
offers.success_metric: Median time from assessment submission to confirmed consult slot (baseline vs pilot); single primary metric, tracked daily.
offers.expected_outcome: Qualitative: same-hour first-touch becomes standard; baseline latency quantified in week 1. No conversion-rate promises.
offers.expansion_opportunity: Roll to remaining 6 locations; then physician-referral acknowledgment automation; then insurance pre-verification checklist assembly.
offers.risk_notes: Highest PHI sensitivity in batch (sleep studies, physician names): BAA + HIPAA-aligned infra mandatory pre-launch; assessment content is health information - AI strictly collects/routes, never interprets; brand voice owned by practice.
offers.proof_required: Assessment-submission export or webhook access for Dallas form; current median response time baseline; CMO sign-off on escalation criteria.

offers.one_sentence_pitch: Every complimentary-consultation lead gets its full follow-up sequence finished - automatically - even when the offices are closed Friday through Sunday.
offers.problem_statement: Growth runs on complimentary consultations, but offices close Fri-Sun while leads arrive continuously, and unfinished follow-up sequences silently leak conversions.
offers.evidence: Complimentary consultation offers on Nextdoor/BubbleLife/site; hours Mon-Thu 8-5 (Yelp/BubbleLife, accessed 2026-08-24); active Facebook/Instagram lead surfaces.
offers.why_it_matters: Free consults are pure acquisition spend; an uncompleted follow-up sequence wastes already-paid acquisition cost.
offers.proposed_ai_workflow: 1) Consult request received (web/social/phone) -> 2) AI confirms appointment + sends prep info -> 3) post-consult day-2/day-7/day-14 educational check-ins (general ortho education only, no advice) -> 4) unresolved questions summarized for staff callback list -> 5) weekly completion report per lead.
offers.human_oversight: Staff review the weekly exception list; any treatment question routed to clinical staff; sequences use practice-approved copy; opt-out honored instantly.
offers.pilot_scope: New consultation requests only, both locations, 30 days. No existing-patient records touched.
offers.success_metric: Percentage of new consult leads receiving the complete 3-touch follow-up within 14 days (target measured against a 2-week pre-pilot baseline audit).
offers.expected_outcome: Qualitative: zero leads lost to sequence gaps; weekend-response gap closed. Conversion lift reported descriptively, not promised.
offers.expansion_opportunity: Extend to adjustment-appointment reminders and aligner-compliance check-ins if phase 1 holds.
offers.risk_notes: Orthodontic content must stay general-educational (no movement predictions/outcome claims); minor-patient communication requires parent/guardian consent flow; TCPA compliant messaging with opt-out.
offers.proof_required: Two-week baseline audit of current follow-up completion; approval of message templates; consent language for minors.

offers.offer_name: Lone Star Bilingual After-Hours Intake & Confirmation Assistant
offers.one_sentence_pitch: English and Spanish-speaking patients of Lone Star Dental Care reach a live, capable assistant after hours - and arrive pre-confirmed, not pre-confused.
offers.problem_statement: The practice advertises bilingual service and keeps evening/Saturday hours with phone-first scheduling, concentrating after-hours communication burden on bilingual front-desk availability.
offers.evidence: 'Our Office Speaks English and Spanish' banner; hours to 7PM Tue-Wed + Sat mornings; 'Call us Now to Schedule' primary CTA (site, fetched 2026-08-24).
offers.why_it_matters: Bilingual coverage typically depends on specific staff being present; absence forces English-only service or missed bookings exactly when working families call.
offers.proposed_ai_workflow: 1) After-hours caller chooses EN/ES -> 2) AI collects non-clinical intake (reason category from approved menu, preferred times) -> 3) books into calendar rules or takes structured callback request -> 4) SMS confirmation in caller's language -> 5) bilingual morning digest to front desk.
offers.human_oversight: Approved reason-category menu only; pain/emergency keywords trigger leave-a-message-with-staff-callback path; transcripts reviewed daily initially.
offers.pilot_scope: Closed-hours windows only (weekday nights + Sunday). Existing-patient calls handled as callback requests only.
offers.success_metric: Share of after-hours Spanish-language and English-language intake contacts fully resolved without requiring next-business-day staff rework (measured from AI transcripts + staff verification).
offers.expected_outcome: Qualitative: consistent bilingual after-hours experience; staff mornings start from digests, not voicemail piles. Volume baselined in week 1.
offers.expansion_opportunity: Add PPO-benefits pre-check questions, recall-list outreach, and Saturday overflow live-transfer.
offers.risk_notes: Translation accuracy audited by fluent staff member before expansion; emergency-keyword routing must fail safe to human callbacks; BAA before any PHI touchpoints.
offers.proof_required: Sample of current after-hours voicemail volume; Spanish script review sign-off; calendar rule access.

offers.one_sentence_pitch: No elective treatment plan at Arnica Dental goes quiet - every open veneer or implant plan gets timely, friendly follow-ups and hands Dr. Vasilev a readiness summary before each call-back.
offers.problem_statement: A solo cosmetic practitioner sells considered, high-value elective plans (veneers, implants, smile design) whose decision cycles stall without persistent, low-pressure follow-up that a solo schedule struggles to sustain.
offers.evidence: Premium elective catalog (veneers, implants, smile design, same-day crowns); single-provider model; one shared phone line for appointments AND inquiries (site, fetched 2026-08-24).
offers.why_it_matters: Elective plans decay quietly; patients rarely say no, they go silent, and solo clinicians lack admin slack for systematic check-ins.
offers.proposed_ai_workflow: 1) Practice marks open plans (status only, no clinical content required) -> 2) AI runs scheduled educational nudges + financing-question answers (practice-approved copy) -> 3) interested replies produce a readiness summary (questions asked, concerns stated, preferred times) delivered before staff callback -> 4) unresponsive plans get spaced long-cycle touches.
offers.human_oversight: Dr. Vasilev approves all copy; clinical questions always answered by the dentist; summaries are staff-facing only; patient messages contain zero diagnostic statements.
offers.pilot_scope: Maximum 25 open elective plans, flagged by the practice itself. No chart access needed.
offers.success_metric: Share of enrolled open plans with a documented, logged follow-up touch within each 14-day window (process metric; revenue deliberately NOT promised).
offers.expected_outcome: Qualitative: systematic cadence replaces ad-hoc memory-driven follow-up; dentist receives warm-handoff summaries instead of cold callbacks. Any conversion change reported descriptively.
offers.expansion_opportunity: Recall/reactivation lists and new-patient nurture after process proof.
offers.risk_notes: Smallest-scale pilot by design (solo practice capacity); marketing-message frequency caps to avoid spam perception; BAA required only if plan details include health info - default scope avoids it entirely.
offers.proof_required: Practice-defined open-plan list with contact preferences; template approvals; quiet-hours policy confirmation.
